criteria.requirement: Add JSONProvider.stream(values) returning the application response class with application/x-ndjson, lazily invoking this actual provider.dumps once per consumed value in compact single physical lines plus newline. Preserve custom provider encoding, Unicode/newline escaping and request context through stream_with_context when a request is active. Do not materialize the iterable; response close/failure/normal exhaustion closes its source once, including unstarted close. Empty input works; unsupported or multiline provider output terminates with an explicit error. Document that a late failure after first bytes cannot revise HTTP status, and leave jsonify array behavior unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
